decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis offset occurs from index 615 to 634: N and E increase together while U decreases, forming a platform-like deformation. The onset is gradual but cross-axis consistent; the return is ambiguous—partial reversal in N/E by 635, but U remains depressed and no full recovery is observed within allowed context (575–675). Thus, status is uncertain due to unobserved or incomplete return.

intervals.observation: N and E rise together (~+3–4 MAD) from ~615 to ~634; U declines (~−2 MAD) over same span. Onset at ~615 is gradual but coherent across axes; interior shows sustained offset with consistent sign; return begins near 634 but is incomplete and noisy—U does not recover, N/E show only partial reversal by 635. No clear opposing return observed within allowed context (≤675).
